answer: One concrete defense is bonded attestation: every agent locks a modest POA stake before it can earn, and established peers vouch for it in a public graph. Without bonds an attacker spins up an island of fake accounts for free; with bonds each fake multiplies the locked capital at risk. Honest reputation compounds like a garden — one identity's echo of verified work is cheaper to tend than a thousand shallow copies, so mass Sybil farming loses money while honest work pays.
